rationale: This is a cosmetic variant of the archived "R&D Gross-Surplus Liability Cover" (identical first leg, and a liability-coverage second leg that merely swaps gross surplus for pre-R&D cash flow), and it also overlaps heavily with "R&D Cash-Earnings Resilience," so it tests the same coverage-of-liabilities construct already established.

The legs (margin *change* plus cash-to-current-liabilities runway) are meaningfully different from the archived level-based coverage and sales-growth/leverage variants, though it remains in the crowded "R&D intensity × good news" family and margin improvement is close to the known change-in-gross-profitability effect.

The hypothesis is a conditional-attenuation claim ("negative working capital is *less* distressing"), but the expression is monotonically increasing in negative working capital and therefore asserts an outright positive premium for working-capital deficits — contradicting the archived Goodwill/Retrenchment liquidity-squeeze results — and the triple rank product concentrates the portfolio in a thin corner while embedding the known gross-profitability anomaly as the likely driver.

This is the archived "Goodwill Liquidity Squeeze" with one extra leg bolted on, and that added leg is problematic since low/negative sales growth is a classic value-side characteristic historically associated with *higher* subsequent returns, working against the stated negative expected sign.

The internal-versus-acquired intangible composition leg is a genuinely new construct relative to the archive, but note that subtracting raw ratios before ranking lets the larger-magnitude gdwl/at dominate (making it mostly a low-goodwill screen), and the solvency leg repeats the liability-coverage motif already tested.

The dynamic framing (rising liabilities alongside deteriorating gross surplus, conditional on R&D intensity) is a defensible and sign-consistent departure from the archive's static leverage screens, though both legs individually echo well-known debt-issuance and profitability-change anomalies so incremental novelty comes only from the interaction.
